I'm now integrating considerations for graceful stream shutdown, focusing on draining in-flight messages using Spring Integration and Reactor lifecycle controls. This aligns with our assumptions about standard timeouts and fallback thresholds to prevent indefinite hangs.

technical_and_design_decisions: Migrate gpfdist sink module from spring-xd-modules repository into spring-xd core code structure, providing out-of-the-box GPDB/HAWQ integration.
Implement a GitHub-backed ModuleRegistry provider using GitHub REST APIs / Git library to enable centralized cluster module synchronization.
Extend Flo DSL parser endpoints to provide structured error payloads containing exact position, error code, and detailed contextual messages for better diagnostic reporting.
Expose generic JavaMail properties (including SSL/TLS configuration options) on the Mail source module configuration schema.
Configure HDFS as the default distributed module registry storage location and refactor YARN distribution packaging scripts to remove obsolete custom-modules.zip.
Add auto-execution of xd-shell initialization script (`xd-shell.init`) located in standard configuration paths upon interactive shell startup.
Implement a graceful stream shutdown mechanism using Spring Integration lifecycle management to allow in-flight messages to drain to sinks before stopping stream components.
assumptions: Target environment provides access to test infrastructure including HDFS, RabbitMQ, and Rackspace Cloud instances for benchmarking.
The Flo UI frontend is capable of consuming structured error response payloads returned by the enhanced Flo parser endpoints.
Graceful shutdown will include configurable timeout limits to prevent indefinite blocking during stream undeployment.
All work is performed by a single developer familiar with Spring Framework, Spring Integration, and Spring XD architecture.

activities.activity_name: U1: Core Migration of GPFDIST Sink Module
activities.activity_description: Extract the Reactor-based gpfdist sink from spring-xd-modules repo, integrate it into Spring XD core source tree, update build dependencies, and create unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U2: GitHub-Backed Centralized Module Registry Implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement GitHub backend for ModuleRegistry to allow cluster nodes to pull/push module definitions from/to a centralized GitHub repository.

activities.activity_name: U3: RabbitMQ Scaling Benchmark on Rackspace
activities.activity_description: Develop benchmarking harness, deploy RabbitMQ on Rackspace infrastructure, execute scale testing across multiple xd-container nodes, and report results.

activities.activity_name: U4: Flo Parser Error Reporting Enhancements
activities.activity_description: Improve Flo stream parser endpoints to report granular error locations, diagnostics, and formatted error messages to streamline client-side error handling.

activities.activity_name: U5: Mail Source SSL/TLS and JavaMail Property Support
activities.activity_description: Update Mail source configuration properties to support custom JavaMail options, including SSL/TLS socket factory properties for secure IMAP/SMTP connections.

activities.activity_name: U6: HDFS Module Registry Defaults and YARN Distribution Cleanup
activities.activity_description: Set HDFS as default remote registry path for custom modules, enable shell/REST module uploads directly to HDFS, and remove custom-modules.zip from YARN distribution artifacts.
Add support in xd-shell CLI to automatically load and execute initial script files (e.g., `/etc/springxd/conf/xd-shell.init`) upon startup.

activities.activity_name: U8: Graceful Stream Undeployment and In-Flight Message Draining
activities.activity_description: Implement graceful stream shutdown logic ensuring active in-flight messages complete processing and reach their destination sink before stream container components are stopped.
Perform end-to-end regression testing, verification of cross-module compatibility, build validation, and update system documentation.
